title: Introduction
description: Generate production-ready Next.js client sites from maintained templates.

blocks.title: Who this is for
blocks.text: Developers who install tempjs via npm and generate hotel, real estate, or future client websites. You do not need the templates monorepo unless you maintain templates.

items: Create an empty folder for the client project
Run tempjs <template-id> with --config for theme, brand, and database
Deploy; use tempjs update --check later for template fixes

blocks.title: Generated project docs
blocks.text: Each template ships GETTING_STARTED.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, and README in the client folder after generation.
